notes.title: Over 100 people have signed up for our wishlist 🎉 & this is what it looks like
notes.content:
Over 100 people on the wishlist!
Thanks to you, we've surpassed 100 wishlist members! 🎉 (I was late in noticing the news feature, so it took quite a while for me to post this article after we actually surpassed that number...🙏)

Development of BL Werewolf began with the thought, "I wish there was a game like this...!", so I'm very happy that so many people are excited about the game's theme and content!

We'll continue developing the game so that you can enjoy it!


Current development status
Development is continuing ahead of the autumn release! 

The multiplayer and battle features are complete, so all that's left is to polish it up so that you can enjoy playing it over and over again! 

The sexual explosion shown in the teaser has also been enhanced...!


[previewyoutube="e50pOLgJxe8;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube]

Rough illustration of default job titles completed!
The rough illustrations for the six basic positions have been completed! Some of you may be wondering what the positions are, so let me introduce them to you!


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701769/94d85c84e4eefcf39457d4ef5e3e0bed0db833db.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701769/9cbb8306b317c92811506158373d1e0471fa57d9.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701769/a61b79e3c1cc599e057429222f08fb15d226ad8c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701769/158f1aa0d86d1eb18826b82c348dafc398b604f6.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701769/972855685230a914b3741112df2e50b2f11fe7ef.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701769/dae86f27fa759a9ccaf59a38f245f566ce095ac5.png"][/carousel]
Let me briefly introduce you to the position!

・Normal student (receiver): A student who looks like a "villager"! It's important to know when to use "evacuate"!

・Bari-Tachi: A student who is like a "Werewolf"! He can only attack uke students.

・Secret Account Boy: A student who seems like a "crazy"! Play nicely in sync with the top's movements!

・Dorm Head: A student who seems like a "fortune teller"! You can follow their footsteps. Maybe you can deduce who went to attack whom...

・Disciplinary Committee: A very powerful student! You can suspend one student without voting!

・Fudanshi: A student who seems like a "fortune teller"! You can find out who the bottom and top are!



We are also working hard on creating illustrations and adjusting the balance for other roles, so we will introduce them on another occasion.


4 voice-over introduction videos!
In the teaser PV and Steam description, we briefly mentioned that there is a stamp function for meetings!


[previewyoutube="yKTpHNPgVvY;full"][/previewyoutube]
We asked the voice actors who recorded the audio for these stamps to film introductory videos to give you a better idea of what kind of discussions will take place in BL Werewolf! 

There are four of these fun and wonderful meeting videos, so we hope they will help you imagine what kind of discussions will take place with what kind of role combinations...!
